Alright, I'm calling today the LLM Rain on your Parade Day.

First, OpenAI just squeezed Claude's pressure point...pricing. The new GPT-5.6 price cuts look like a product update, but It's really a competitive move. 

But after what seemed like seconds it got bumped off being the pricing leader?

Anthropic also has a very visible weakness: compute and pricing. You've experienced it: rate limits and expensive high-end usage that runs out faster than sugar at a lemonade stand.

So, the headlines today are hard to ignore: GPT-5.6 Luna is now 80% cheaper. And yes, that sounds huge.

And then almost simultaneously, DeepSeek V4 Flash was announced with a Cost per Task comes in at ~60% lower than GPT-5.6 Luna with the much beloved GLM 5.2 performance. 

This is the new workhorse leader, the pricing is ridiculous. That puts it at the same level of intelligence as Gemini Flash and still orders of magnitude cheaper.

Whether you use it depends on your tolerance for Chinese vs American models. GPT 5.6 is already available.
